newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end barely higher in quiet session.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end barely higher in quiet session.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange juice futures settled barely firmer in quiet trading, with little fundamental news to prompt any major moves in either direction, traders said.

"In order for me to get bullish in this market, we would have had to close over the 76.00 cents per pound level in the May contract," a broker said. "However, we did not, and I look for a continuation of the slide."
May orange juice settled 0.10 cent firmer at 75.65 cents, traded 76.40 to 75.20 cents.
July, which now has almost the same amount of open interest as spot May, went out 0.15 cents lower at 78.00 cents. All the other back months ended weaker.
Volume was low at an estimated 2,500 lots.

The CFTC Commitment of Traders report released late Friday appeared bearish with a sharp increase in the amount of short positions held by speculators in the two weeks ended April 8, up 3,088 to 5,546 lots.
Also on Friday the USDA raised its output and yield in its monthly Florida crop estimate.
